name: omb-agent
description: A multi-agent orchestration platform that coordinates AI agents — built with AutoGen and CrewAI. It integrates with n8n for workflow automation, Dify for RAG pipelines, and Telegram for conversational interfaces. The platform manages AI agents as composable skills with semantic routing.
highlights: Multi-agent orchestration with AutoGen and CrewAI
Skill-based architecture with semantic routing
Integration with n8n, Dify, Telegram, and Qdrant
Dockerized deployment with CI/CD pipeline

name: tg-scheduler
description: A Telegram-based scheduling bot that connects messaging with Google services (Calendar, Sheets) and custom data pipelines. Handles automated notifications, event scheduling, and data logging through natural language commands.
highlights: Natural language command processing via Telegram
Google Calendar and Google Sheets integration
Automated notifications and reminders
Production-ready Docker deployment

name: tgkart2googlph
description: An automation pipeline that forwards media from Telegram forwarded messages to Google Photos, creating an organized photo backup system with metadata preservation.
highlights: Telegram message scraping and media extraction
Google Photos API integration for backup
Metadata preservation and organization
Containerized with Docker Compose

name: garmin2googlesheet
description: An ETL pipeline that extracts fitness metrics from Garmin Connect and syncs them to Google Sheets for structured analysis and visualization. Enables custom fitness dashboards and trend tracking.
highlights: Automated Garmin Connect data extraction
Google Sheets API integration for structured storage
Scheduled sync with configurable intervals
Enables custom fitness analytics and visualization

name: infra-as-code
description: A comprehensive Docker-based local development environment for orchestrating production-like infrastructure and application stacks. Manages 15+ services including databases, queues, vector stores, reverse proxy, and watchtower auto-updates — all through version-controlled Docker Compose configurations.
highlights: 15+ Docker Compose stacks for various services
Integrated dev-container with VS Code workspace
Automated secrets management and secret rotation
GitHub Actions for CI/CD and security scanning

name: hon
description: Home Assistant custom integration for Haier hOn ecosystem — supporting Haier, Candy, and Hoover home appliances in 19 languages. Enables smart home control of washing machines, air conditioners, and more.
highlights: Multi-brand support (Haier, Candy, Hoover)
19 language locales
Home Assistant native integration
IoT smart home automation
